q.g: In this quest you have to place two WI-FI Cameras in the Klimova 16A building on Streets of Tarkov. A Rusted bloody key is required. One has to be placed in the staircase in front of the locked door on the fourth floor, and the other one has to be placed at the heater next to the chained door in the area behind the locked door.

sh.c: Klimova 16A building location marked on map
Cosmonaut painting on the south side of the building
Third to fourth floor stairs with trash that has to be climbed over
Locked door on the fourth floor
First camera location at the heater next to the chained door
Second camera location at the trash bags in front of the locked door
